ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.

2. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.

3. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the library

4. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.

5. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.

6. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. No full stops
   D. Only one word repeated

7. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. blue
   C. quickly
   D. run

8. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.

9. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.

10. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goes
   C. goed
   D. went

11. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only an action
   D. Only a joining word

12. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.

13. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.

14. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Language Activities at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
